interface.signature: def omit_hashtag(message: str, hashtag: str) -> str

preconditions.description: The message parameter must be a string.
The hashtag parameter must be a string.

preconditions.expression: hashtag.startswith('#') and all(c.isalnum() for c in hashtag[1:])
preconditions.description: The hashtag must start with '#' followed only by alphanumeric characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == message.replace(hashtag, '', 1) if hashtag in message else message
postconditions.description: If the hashtag appears in the message, return the message with the first occurrence of the hashtag removed; otherwise, return the message unchanged.
